name: voice-of-customer
title_zh: 评论工单聊天记录，揉成主题簇与人物卡
tagline_zh: 散在五个后台的客户原话，终于能拼出「谁在抱怨、抱怨什么」。它按主题聚类再切情绪。
tagline_en: Customer quotes scattered across five tools finally become 'who's complaining and about what' — clustered by.
desc_en: Mine customer reviews, support tickets, WhatsApp chats and CRM notes for themes, sentiment patterns and persona signals. Produce theme clusters, sentiment cuts and persona cards for D2C brands. Use when the founder asks what customers are saying, wants persona research, sentiment analysis, review synthesis, support ticket patterns, or to understand the voice of the customer. Triggers on phrases li
why_zh: 先聚类再切情绪，顺序不反。所以你能看到「物流慢」里其实混着两拨人：一拨要退款，一拨只想改地址。
why_en: Cluster first, then cut sentiment — so you see that 'slow shipping' hides two groups: one wants a refund, one just wants to.
limit_zh: 只吃文本：评论、工单、聊天、CRM 备注。语音、电话录音、纯星级评分它读不了。样本少于 200 条时聚类不稳。
limit_en: Text only: reviews, tickets, chats, CRM notes. No voice, call recordings, or bare star ratings. Under ~200 samples clustering is unstable — it says.
title_en: Reviews, tickets, chats turned into themes and persona cards
